== Quest information ==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = nightfall
}}

=== Objectives ===
* Meet [[Nobleman Emrah]] and his fellow Vabbians in [[Lahtenda Bog]].
* Escort the Vabbians on their hike to the Sunspear Crypt in Lahtenda Bog.
* See [[Nobleman Emrah]] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 1,500 [[Experience]]
* 125 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==
Follow the map to the quest marker, killing any foes you encounter. Watch out for popup Mandragors and roving Insects.

== NPCs ==
=== Allies ===
*{{x}} 10 [[Nobleman Emrah]]
*{{x}} 10 [[Vabbian Noble]]

== Dialogue ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
'''Clerk Arlon'''
:''"That's right, <player's name>, I have another job for you.  Remember those Vabbian noblemen you dragged all over the [[Zehlon Reach]]?  Well, they're planning another outing and specifically requested you to accompany them.  This time those loonies want to see the Sunspear Crypt in [[Lahtenda Bog]].  When I told them how dangerous such a trip would be, it only made them more excited.  As before, their vast diplomatic budget will pay your expenses.  Are you interested?"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = You pay, I'll guard.  [[Lahtenda Bog]] you said?
| decline = Are you kidding?  They almost got me killed last time.  No way!
| ask = That's right, they are in [[Lahtenda Bog]] expecting their great protector to join them there.  Amazing what these Vabbian noblemen will pay for.
}}

=== Reward dialogue ===
'''Nobleman Emrah'''
: ''"You are quite good, aren't you?  Again, you have impressed us with your prowess, and protected us through countless dangers.  Well worth the money, I say!"''

== Notes ==
* This quest can be combined with the quest [[Crypt-ology]] as both lead to the same spot in [[Lahtenda bog]].
* You can also do the quests [[Down on the Bayou]] and [[Wandered Off Again]] while working on this quest.
